observation.command:
COOKIE=/tmp/op_cookies.txt
curl -s -b $COOKIE -o /tmp/acct.html -w "account HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/my/account
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/acct.html | head -1
echo "=== whoami via session ==="
curl -s -b $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/my/account | grep -o -i "admin" | head -3
echo "=== container health ==="
docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}} restarts={{.RestartCount}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}n/a{{end}}' openproject
docker ps --filter name=openproject --format '{{.Status}}'
echo "=== listening port ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "final root HTTP %{http_code}\n" -L http://localhost:8080/
